original_value: T7 Touch 2TB V-NAND USB 3.2 Gen 2 External SSD. The Samsung 2TB T7 Touch Portable SSD is a compact and secure storage solution that fits in the palm of your hand. Roughly the size of a few stacked credit cards, the T7 Touch is equipped 256-bit AES encryption, a fingerprint reader, and password protection, so users can rest assured knowing their data is safe. Moreover, with PCIe NVMe technology, the T7 Touch offers users quick performance and little downtime with read and write speeds of up to 1050 MB/s and 1000 MB/s respectively. With a USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C port, it's also backwards compatible with USB 3.0 and Type-A devices with an appropriate cable.

result.paraphrase: Samsung T7 Touch 2TB portable external SSD with V-NAND and USB 3.2 Gen 2. This compact drive fits in the palm of your hand and is about the size of a few stacked credit cards. It offers secure storage with 256-bit AES encryption, fingerprint authentication, and password protection. Using PCIe NVMe technology, it delivers fast performance with read speeds up to 1050 MB/s and write speeds up to 1000 MB/s. Its USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C port is also backward compatible with USB 3.0 and Type-A devices when used with the appropriate cable.
